tasks.title: Aqueducts
paras: Aqueducts were designed to transport water from distant sources into cities and agricultural areas, and they were crucial engineering feats in ancient civilizations. This engineering marvel allowed civilizations to thrive in otherwise inhospitable environments. The Romans, in particular, mastered the construction of aqueducts, building extensive networks that supplied water to urban centers. These structures used a combination of gravity and meticulously calculated gradients to ensure a steady flow of water. Some Roman aqueducts, like the Pont du Gard in France, are still standing today, showcasing the Romans’ remarkable engineering skills. In addition to providing water for drinking and irrigation, aqueducts were integral to public health and sanitation. They supplied water to public baths, helping to maintain hygiene in densely populated urban areas. The availability of fresh water also supported the growth of cities and the expansion of the Roman Empire. Building aqueducts was a complex and labor-intensive process. Workers had to carve channels through mountains and construct bridges over valleys. Despite these challenges, the benefits of aqueducts far outweighed the difficulties. The legacy of Roman aqueducts continues to influence modern water management systems, highlighting the importance of sustainable engineering practices.

questions.stem: The word “meticulously” in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 词汇题 原文定位： “These structures used a combination of gravity and meticulously calculated gradients to ensure a steady flow of water.” 正确答案分析： “meticulously” 意为“细致地、一丝不苟地”，在句中修饰“calculated gradients”（计算的坡度），表示计算非常精确。因此 “precisely”（精确地）是最接近的含义。 选项分析： (A) inaccurately 不精确地 —— 反义词。 (B) precisely 精确地 —— 正确。 (C) vaguely 模糊地 —— 反义词。 (D) carelessly 粗心地 —— 反义词。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the workers who built the aqueducts?

options.D: They were not aware of the aqueducts' importance.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 推断题 原文定位： “Building aqueducts was a complex and labor-intensive process. Workers had to carve channels through mountains and construct bridges over valleys.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出修建水道是“复杂且劳动密集的过程”，工人们需要在山中开凿渠道、在山谷上架桥。由此可以推断，工人们面临着巨大的体力挑战。因此选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) They were not very skilled. 他们技术不高 —— 与文中展现的工程难度相悖。 (B) They faced significant physical challenges. 他们面临重大的体力挑战 —— 正确。 (C) They primarily worked on bridges. 他们主要在桥上工作 —— 过于片面，他们还需开凿山体。 (D) They were not aware of the aqueducts' importance. 他们没有意识到水道的重要性 —— 文中未提及。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention the Pont du Gard in France?

options.A: To illustrate how aqueducts were constructed
options.B: To give an example of a well-preserved aqueduct
options.C: To explain the importance of aqueducts in France
options.D: To describe the engineering techniques used by the Romans

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 修辞目的题 原文定位： “Some Roman aqueducts, like the Pont du Gard in France, are still standing today, showcasing the Romans’ remarkable engineering skills.” 正确答案分析： 作者提到法国的加尔桥，是为了举例说明有些罗马水道至今仍然屹立不倒，以此展示罗马人卓越的工程技能。因此选项 B 正确，即“给出一个保存完好的水道的例子”。 选项分析： (A) To illustrate how aqueducts were constructed 说明水道是如何建造的 —— 文中未描述建造过程。 (B) To give an example of a well-preserved aqueduct 给出一个保存完好的水道的例子 —— 正确。 (C) To explain the importance of aqueducts in France 解释水道在法国的重要性 —— 文中未侧重法国。 (D) To describe the engineering techniques used by the Romans 描述罗马人使用的工程技术 —— 加尔桥是展示成果，而非描述技术本身。

questions.stem: What role did aqueducts play in the expansion of the Roman Empire?

options.A: They facilitated the transportation of goods.
options.B: They provided water for drinking and sanitation.
options.C: They helped in building bridges over valleys.
options.D: They enabled the construction of public baths.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型： 细节题 原文定位： “In addition to providing water for drinking and irrigation, aqueducts were integral to public health and sanitation. ... The availability of fresh water also supported the growth of cities and the expansion of the Roman Empire.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出，水道不仅提供饮用水和灌溉用水，还对公共卫生和 sanitation 至关重要，并且淡水供应支持了城市的发展和罗马帝国的扩张。因此选项 B 正确。 选项分析： (A) They facilitated the transportation of goods. 它们促进了货物运输 —— 文中未提及。 (B) They provided water for drinking and sanitation. 它们提供了饮用水和卫生用水 —— 正确。 (C) They helped in building bridges over valleys. 它们帮助在山谷上架桥 —— 这是建造过程，而非帝国扩张的作用。 (D) They enabled the construction of public baths. 它们使公共浴场的建造成为可能 —— 这只是部分作用，不如 B 全面。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about modern water management systems?

options.A: They no longer use principles from Roman engineering.
options.B: They are less efficient than Roman aqueducts.
options.C: They are influenced by Roman engineering practices.
options.D: They are not as labor-intensive as Roman aqueducts.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：C 题型： 推断题 原文定位： “The legacy of Roman aqueducts continues to influence modern water management systems, highlighting the importance of sustainable engineering practices.” 正确答案分析： 文中明确指出，罗马水道的遗产持续影响着现代水管理系统。由此可以推断，现代水管理系统受到了罗马工程实践的影响。因此选项 C 正确。 选项分析： (A) They no longer use principles from Roman engineering. 它们不再使用罗马工程的原则 —— 与原文“持续影响”矛盾。 (B) They are less efficient than Roman aqueducts. 它们不如罗马水道高效 —— 文中未比较效率。 (C) They are influenced by Roman engineering practices. 它们受到罗马工程实践的影响 —— 正确。 (D) They are not as labor-intensive as Roman aqueducts. 它们不像罗马水道那样劳动密集 —— 文中未比较劳动强度。
